part1.title: Zombie Outbreak: Trapped In A Beach Surf Shop With 40 Infected, Don't Run For The Roads (1/3) #shorts
part1.description:
If zombies trap you in a beach town, don't run for the roads. Run for the water. Kai has 40 infected at the glass, two longboards, and a tide going out.

Paddle out? Part 2 is up next.
#zombie #survival #horror #beach #storytime #shorts
part1.comment: Paddle out? 🌊 Would you run for the water? YES or NO 👇

part2.title: Zombie Outbreak: Escaped Into The Ocean, Then A Rip Current Pulled Us Out (2/3) #shorts
part2.description:
If a rip current grabs you: don't fight it. Swim sideways, parallel to the beach, then come in. Kai and Tess have to do it at night... with the infected walking along the shore beside them.

Kick free? Part 3 is up next.
#zombie #survival #horror #beach #storytime #shorts
part2.comment: Kick free? 🧟 Would you stay on the board? YES or NO 👇

part3.title: Zombie Outbreak: Half A Mile Out At Night, Something Grabbed My Ankle (3/3) #shorts
part3.description:
An infected lifeguard has Kai's ankle. Half a mile from shore, in the dark. The finale of Last Wave.

Rip current rule: don't fight it, go sideways, then come in.
Paddle out? Tell me in the comments.
#zombie #survival #horror #beach #storytime #shorts
part3.comment: Paddle out? 🌊 Would YOU have run for the water? 👇
